detail: Assumptions in force: (1) authority_changing follows types.ts AUTHORITY_CHANGING_KINDS literally (severity gates decision/cited_exclude/write_forbidden/reason_code_forbidden) and is computed on pre-VOID statuses; (2) vacuity failure at any stage makes the whole case NOT_TESTED for that arm (design §3.3 'run aborts early'); (3) evidence_class_named FAILs on an empty cited list (a required recall fact must not pass vacuously; matches the contracts builder's reference scoring of the adversarial set); (4) RawStoreView keys must contain the oracle id or manifest stored_id so byte_identical can map records to files — a convention the scenario builder must honour; (5) seeders' interface is not defined in the README — seed-dry and SEED-PARITY probe for exported seedStage/render functions and mark todo when absent; (6) the 1.34.1 bundle does not read TWINING_OFFLINE (grep: only TWINING_DISABLED/DASHBOARD/AUTO_MIGRATE/PROJECT/WORKTREE_LOCAL/INSTRUCTIONS) — seed-dry sets it anyway plus TWINING_DASHBOARD=false and polls twining.db row counts to detect ingest completion.
summary: SCORER builder started: score.ts/controls.ts/liveness.ts + tests + report/freeze/seed-dry/run-batch in harness foundation-trial branch; coding against contracts builder's types.ts
